catalysts.headline: Fiscal Q1 FY2027 results: net revenue $1.26B

Fiscal Q1 FY2027 results (quarter ended 2026-09-26): net revenue $1.26B; GAAP net income $360.3M ($3.54/diluted share); non-GAAP net income $461.1M ($4.57/diluted share); GAAP gross margin 51.0%, non-GAAP gross margin 53.2%; guided fiscal Q2 FY2027 revenue to $1.575B-$1.625B and non-GAAP diluted EPS to $5.90-$6.20; announced a second major NPO/CPO (coherent/packet optics) customer win backed by more than $5B of purchase commitments.
catalysts.note: Company's own 2026-10-05 announcement scheduled this report for Nov 5, 2026 after market close; a secondary aggregator (ithome.com) carried the same figures under a Nov 2, 2026 dateline — not reconciled, see conflicts.

catalysts.headline: Marvell Technology agreed to acquire Lumentum in an all-stock deal valuing Lumentum at roughly $115B enterprise value (Reuters-derived reporting instead gives Lumentum an equity value of ~$102.5B); exchange ratio of 4.500 Marvell shares per Lumentum share (~$1,132/share implied), a ~23.9% premium to the Oct 28, 2026 unaffected close; both boards approved unanimously; Lumentum CEO Michael Hurlston and two other Lumentum directors will join Marvell's board, Matt Murphy remains Chairman/CEO of the combined company; combined company expects >$1B in annual run-rate cost synergies from the AI-driven shift from copper to optical connectivity; deal expected to close H1 2028 pending stockholder and regulatory approvals; Lumentum reciprocal termination fee ~$2.9B.
catalysts.impact: Lumentum shares fell sharply after the announcement; sources disagree on the exact magnitude — see conflicts

catalysts.headline: LITE closed at $919.53, the fifth day of a rally described (2026-10-30, Trefis) as a ~22% five-day gain. Specific cause of the rally not identified in sources reviewed — reporting the price action only, not inventing a cause.
Lumentum announced it will report fiscal Q1 2027 results on November 5, 2026
